# Docker Deployment Guide

This directory contains Docker configuration and environment files for deploying the EA MkDocs platform to different environments.
page_texts.2:
[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/docker/README.md#-architecture]

## 🏗️ Architecture

The Docker setup uses a **single image** with **runtime configuration** approach, which provides flexibility and follows container best practices:

- **Single Dockerfile** builds for all environments
- **Environment-specific build arguments** configure the site at build time
- **Multi-stage build** optimizes image size and security
- **Nginx serving** provides production-ready static file serving

[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/docker/README.md#environment-templates]

### Environment Templates

This project provides environment templates for different deployment scenarios:

- **`.env.example`** - Local development configuration (MkDocs serve)
- **`env-dev`** - Development environment template (remote Docker deployment)
- **`env-prod`** - Production environment template (remote Docker deployment)
- **`env-eks-template.env`** - Complete ECR + EKS deployment template

[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/docker/README.md#local-development]

#### Local Development

```bash

cp .env.example .env

# Edit .env with your local settings
ENVIRONMENT=local
MKDOCS_SITE_NAME="EA Reference Architecture (LOCAL)"
MKDOCS_SITE_URL="http://localhost:8000"

# Use built-in MkDocs server for local development
python _helpers/build.py --serve
```

[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/docker/README.md#ecr--eks-deployment]

#### ECR + EKS Deployment

```bash
# Copy the ECR/EKS template
cp env-eks-template.env .env.eks.dev

# Edit .env.eks.dev with your AWS settings:
ECR_REGISTRY_URL=707203271462.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com
ECR_REPOSITORY_NAME=pfe-pg-dev-us1-cm-ecr-platform-shared
ECR_IMAGE_TAG_PREFIX=eap-mkdocs-platform
ECR_IMAGE_TAG_STRATEGY=git-commit
MKDOCS_SITE_URL=https://eap-reference.shared.dev.pgwcloud.net
MKDOCS_SITE_HOST=eap-reference.shared.dev.pgwcloud.net

# Load environment and build
source .env.eks.dev
python _helpers/scripts/build_docker.py --docker-env=dev --push
```

[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/docker/README.md#quick-start-guide]

### Quick Start Guide

1. **Choose your deployment target:**

   - Local development → Use `.env.example`
   - ECR + EKS deployment → Use `env-eks-template.env`

2. **Configure environment:**

   ```bash
   # For local development
   cp .env.example .env

   # For ECR/EKS deployment
   cp env-eks-template.env .env.eks.staging
   ```

3. **Build and deploy:**

   ```bash
   # Local development (built-in MkDocs server)
   python _helpers/build.py --serve

   # Remote dev build
   python _helpers/scripts/build_docker.py --docker-env=dev

   # Remote prod build and push
   source .env.eks.prod
   python _helpers/scripts/build_docker.py --docker-env=prod --push
   ```

  --build-arg ENVIRONMENT=dev \
  --build-arg SITE_URL=https://eap-reference.shared.dev.pgwcloud.net \
  --build-arg SITE_NAME="EA Reference Architecture (DEV)" \

  --build-arg ENVIRONMENT=prod \
  --build-arg SITE_URL=https://eap-reference.pgwproper.net \
  --build-arg SITE_NAME="EA Reference Architecture" \
  -t eap-mkdocs-platform:prod .

[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/docker/README.md#aws-eks-deployment]

### AWS EKS Deployment

```yaml
# Kubernetes Deployment (example)
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: eap-mkdocs-platform-prod
  namespace: docs
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: eap-mkdocs-platform
      environment: production
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: eap-mkdocs-platform
        environment: production
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: eap-mkdocs-platform
          image: 707203271462.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/pfe-pg-dev-us1-cm-ecr-platform-shared:eap-mkdocs-platform-latest-production
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
              name: http
          resources:
            requests:
              memory: "128Mi"
              cpu: "100m"
            limits:
              memory: "512Mi"
              cpu: "500m"
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: 8080
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 30
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: 8080
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 10
          securityContext:
            runAsNonRoot: true
            runAsUser: 101
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: eap-mkdocs-platform-service
  namespace: docs
spec:
  selector:
    app: eap-mkdocs-platform
    environment: production
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 8080
      name: http
  type: ClusterIP
```

[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/docker/README.md#common-issues]

### Common Issues

1. **Build Failures**

   - Check Docker daemon is running
   - Verify network connectivity for dependency downloads
   - Ensure sufficient disk space

2. **Container Won't Start**

   - Check logs: `docker logs <container-id>`
   - Verify port availability: `docker port <container-id>`
   - Test health check manually: `curl http://localhost:8080/health`

3. **Site Not Loading**
   - Verify build completed successfully
   - Check Nginx configuration syntax
   - Ensure static files are present in `/usr/share/nginx/html`

[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/docker/README.md#debug-commands]

### Debug Commands

```bash
# Run container interactively for debugging
docker run -it --entrypoint /bin/sh eap-mkdocs-platform:latest

# Check container file structure
docker run --rm eap-mkdocs-platform:latest find /usr/share/nginx/html -type f

# Test Nginx configuration
docker run --rm eap-mkdocs-platform:latest nginx -t

# View build manifest
cat .tmp/build-manifest-production.json
```
